title: 连读
goal: 判断相邻两词之间的连读方式；把连读的语流还原成单词。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 口语

points.label: 判断相邻两词之间的连读方式
把连读的语流还原成单词

body.p: 连读是相邻两个词之间的音连在一起。单词的拼写、顺序和语法作用都不变。判断连读方式，看前词的最后一个音和后词的第一个音，不看字母。两个词之间没有停顿，仍然是两个词。
‿ 标出本课讲的词间连接。连读的实际发音随口音、语速和重读而变。书面题判断可能的连接方式。录音题只要求还原说出的词，不要求听出是否有闪音或失去爆破。

cards.title: 辅音之间的连接
rows: /n/ 直接连到后面的元音上，中间不加元音。
/k/ 直接连到后面的元音上，仍是两个词。
末尾的 e 不发音，/v/ 连到后面的元音上。
/n/ 连到 orange 上，但 n 仍属于 an。
An orange folder contains the forms.
两个 /p/ 可共享一次较长的闭塞，不多出音节。
两个 /k/ 可共享闭塞，仍是两个词。
The black coat is on the hook.
两个 /g/ 可共享闭塞，只爆破一次。
/t/、/d/ 发音部位相同，可连续过渡。
The plants need shade on a hot day.

cards.title: 元音过渡与失去爆破
rows: /iː/ 后面接元音，中间会带出一个轻的 /j/。
The scale is small, but I can see it.
/eɪ/ 后面接元音，中间会带出一个轻的 /j/。
The results arrived the day after the trial.
/oʊ/ 后面接元音，中间会带出一个轻的 /w/。
The crew will go out at dawn.
/uː/ 后面接元音，中间会带出一个轻的 /w/。
/t/ 在 /b/ 前可只做出闭塞，不明显爆破。
That book contains the updated diagram.
/d/ 在 /p/ 前可不明显爆破，词仍是 good。
The team agreed on a good plan.
/d/ 在 /b/ 前可不明显爆破，仍属于 red。
The tools are in the red bag.
/t/ 在 /k/ 前可不明显爆破，不加额外元音。
The reader found a quiet corner.

cards.title: 美音的闪音
rows: /t/ 前为重读元音，后接非重读元音。
/t/ 可发成舌尖轻碰一下的 [ɾ]。
The instructions are clear; I get it.
/t/ 在连续语流的两个元音之间。
it 不重读时常发成 [ɾ]，重读 it 时可能不发。
听起来接近短促的 d，但词仍是 write，不是 ride。
Write it on the blank line.
听起来像 d，拼写仍是 cut。
Cut it along the dotted edge.

body.box: Please put it in an empty drawer.

body.p: put it 的 /t/ 可能发成闪音。in an 和 an empty 都是 /n/ 接元音。这些连读都不改变原来的词。

body.box:
Please / put it / in / an empty drawer .
Extra chunk: a empty drawer

body.p: an 的 /n/ 连到 empty 上，但仍属于冠词 an。还原为 Please put it in an empty drawer。多余词块 a empty drawer 与录音不符，元音前也应该用 an。

groups.text: Target boundary: leave early. The last sound of leave is /v/.

options: A /j/-like transition between vowels
A shared closure between identical stops
A consonant joining the next vowel
An unreleased /t/ before a stop
items.why: leave 的末音 /v/ 是辅音，early 首音为元音，属于辅音加元音。

groups.text: Target boundary: two apples. The final vowel of two is /uː/.

options: A /w/-like transition
A /j/-like transition
A shared /p/ closure
A flap replacing /t/
items.why: two 的 /uː/ 后面接 apples 的元音，中间可有 /w/ 样过渡，即第一项。

groups.text: Target boundary: black coat. Both boundary sounds are /k/.

options: Add a new vowel between the two stops.
Add a /j/-like glide between the two words.
Treat the two words as one written noun.
Let the adjacent stops share a closure.
items.why: black coat 的两个 /k/ 可共享闭塞，两个词都保留，即第四项。

groups.text: Target boundary: write it. The vowel in it is unstressed.

items.stem: Which American English realization is possible?
options: An added /w/ after write
A flap realization of /t/
An unreleased final /t/
A /j/-like glide before it
items.why: write it 中 /t/ 位于重读元音与非重读元音之间，可实现为闪音 [ɾ]。

lines.text: Please pick up the empty basket after lunch.

items.why: 原句 pick up 的辅音接元音，词组仍是 pick up；pick out 改变原词。

lines.text: The crew will go out through the narrow door.

items.why: 原句 go out 在元音之间可有过渡音，不能把 out 改为 on。

lines.text: A red bag contains the spare straps.

items.stem: Put the heard chunks in their original order.
items.why: red bag 的 /d/ 可能不明显爆破，仍须保留 bag 而不是 badge。

lines.text: Please write it beside the total on the form.

items.stem: Reconstruct the sentence from the recording.
items.why: 原词为 write it，即使 /t/ 出现闪音，也不能改写为 ride it。

groups.text: Target boundary: an orange. The boundary sounds are /n/ and a vowel.

options: A consonant connects directly to a following vowel.
Two identical consonants share one closure.
A /w/ transition occurs between two vowels.
A final /t/ becomes a flap before an unstressed vowel.
items.why: an orange 的 /n/ 直接接后词元音，词间连接不改变冠词 an。

groups.text: Compare see it with go out. Both pairs meet at vowel sounds.

items.stem: Which pair of possible transitions matches that order?
options: /w/ after see; /j/ after go
/j/ after see; /w/ after go
/j/ after see; /j/ after go
/w/ after see; /w/ after go
items.why: see 的 /iː/ 后可有 /j/ 样过渡，go 的 /oʊ/ 后可有 /w/ 样过渡。

groups.text: Compare big gate with good plan. The boundaries are /g g/ and /d p/.

items.stem: Which account matches the two boundaries?
options: Both boundaries may share a single closure.
The first may share a closure; the second may have a flap.
The first may share a closure; the second may have an unreleased /d/.
The first may have an unreleased /d/; the second may share two /g/ sounds.
items.why: big gate 的 /g g/ 可共享闭塞；good plan 的 /d/ 在 /p/ 前可失去明显爆破。

groups.text: Target boundary: cut it. The first vowel is stressed and the vowel in it is unstressed.

items.stem: Which account fits a possible American English realization?
options: The boundary must gain a separate vowel.
The /t/ must become a flap, and the words become cud it.
The boundary must contain two /t/ closures.
The /t/ may be a flap while the words stay cut it.
items.why: cut it 的 /t/ 可实现为 [ɾ]，但原词和拼写不变。

lines.text: The volunteer will turn off the desk fan.

items.why: 原句 turn off 中 /n/ 接元音；off 不能被相关词 on 替换。

lines.text: The students will see it after the screening.

items.why: 原句 see it 可有 /j/ 样过渡，但宾语仍为 it，不是 them。

lines.text: That book belongs on the reference shelf.

items.stem: Put the heard chunks in their original order.
items.why: 原句 That book 中 /t/ 在 /b/ 前可不明显爆破，名词仍为 book。

lines.text: The assistant will put it under the display stand.

items.stem: Reconstruct the sentence from the recording.
items.why: 原句 put it 中的连接不改变代词 it；多余词块把宾语换为 them。
